options.name: Hidden Sight
options.description: Activating Allfather's Cloak refreshes Eye of the Allfather. Using the tactical while cloaked hides its scan visual from enemies.
options.descriptionZh: 开启众神之父斗篷会刷新众神之眼。在隐身状态下使用战术技能时，敌人看不到该扫描的视觉效果。

options.name: Bird's Eye
options.description: White Ravens split and fly toward the two nearest enemies belonging to different squads.
options.descriptionZh: 白乌鸦会分开飞向最近的 2 名敌人，且这 2 名敌人属于不同小队。

options.name: Hunter's Agility
options.description: Reduces Eye of the Allfather activation time by 20% and its cooldown by 5 seconds.
options.descriptionZh: 众神之眼的启动时间缩短 20%，冷却时间减少 5 秒。

options.name: True Predator
options.description: Firing a weapon while cloaked only interrupts the cloak temporarily instead of breaking it permanently. Respawn did not publish the re-cloak delay.
options.descriptionZh: 隐身状态下开枪只会暂时中断隐身，而不是永久打断。Respawn 未公布重新隐身延迟。

options.name: Thunder Dome
options.description: Electrified Dome of Protection deals 50 damage and slow the first enemy to cross.
options.descriptionZh: 电能化防护穹盾会对第一个穿过的敌人造成 50 点伤害并施加减速。

options.name: Healing Dome
options.description: Dome of Protection duration increases 4s (12s→16s). and heal double for players while in the Dome of Protection.
options.descriptionZh: 防护穹盾持续时间增加 4 秒（12 秒→16 秒），并让防护穹盾内玩家受到的治疗效果翻倍。

options.name: Triple Bombardment
options.description: Get 3 charges of the Defensive Bombardment with smaller radius.
options.descriptionZh: 获得 3 次防御性轰炸充能，但轰炸半径更小。

options.name: Fast Shotties
options.description: Move at holstered speed while using shotguns and auto-reload shotguns on knock.
options.descriptionZh: 使用霰弹枪时以收枪速度移动；击倒敌人后自动装填霰弹枪。

options.name: Extended Flight
options.description: Increase Combat Glide time by 1.5s (4s → 5.5s).
options.descriptionZh: 战斗滑翔持续时间增加 1.5 秒（4 秒 → 5.5 秒）。

options.name: Battpack
options.description: Carry +1 per stack (2 → 3) and see batteries counter over Death Boxes.
options.descriptionZh: 每格可多携带 1 个护盾电池（2 → 3），并显示死亡箱内的护盾电池数量。

options.name: Enhanced Radio
options.description: D.O.C. Heal Drone assignment range +50%.
options.descriptionZh: D.O.C. 治疗无人机的指派范围 +50%。

options.name: Tactical Cooldown+
options.description: D.O.C. Heal Drone cooldown reduced by 10 seconds (45s → 35s).
options.descriptionZh: D.O.C. 治疗无人机冷却时间减少 10 秒（45 秒 → 35 秒）。

options.name: Field Research
options.description: Gain access to Recon perks.
options.descriptionZh: 获得侦察型职业天赋。

options.name: Ringmaster
options.description: Gain access to Controller perks.
options.descriptionZh: 获得控制型职业天赋。

options.name: Landing Gear
options.description: Gain better air control and softer landings.
options.descriptionZh: 获得更好的空中操控和更柔和的落地效果。

options.name: Feeling Zippy
options.description: +1 Zipline Gun charge and improve ally energized speed.
options.descriptionZh: 滑索枪充能 +1，并提升队友的充能状态速度加成。

options.name: Sixth Sense
options.description: Voices from the Void warns you when a new squad comes within 150 meters.
options.descriptionZh: 当新的小队进入 150 米范围内时，虚空之声会发出警告。

options.name: Phase Dome
options.description: While casting Dimensional Rift, the portal entrance gains a Phase Dome, phasing anyone inside of it.
options.descriptionZh: 施放维度裂隙时，传送门入口会获得一个相位穹顶，使其中所有人进入相位状态。

options.name: Fast Phase
options.description: Into the Void activates 30% faster (0.8s → 0.5s).
options.descriptionZh: 踏入虚空启动速度加快 30%（0.8 秒 → 0.5 秒）。

options.name: Void Jumper
options.description: Into the Void's duration increased by 2 seconds (4s → 6s) and enables the ability to perform a double jump while in the void.
options.descriptionZh: 踏入虚空持续时间增加 2 秒（4 秒 → 6 秒），并可在虚空中进行二段跳。

options.name: Electric Smoke
options.description: Smoke Launcher now deals 100 damage to enemy deployables.
options.descriptionZh: 烟雾发射器现在会对敌方部署物造成 100 点伤害。

options.name: Cover Me!
options.description: Allies regenerate HP while inside smoke. Auto-ping enemies who trigger Double Time.
options.descriptionZh: 队友在烟雾中会恢复生命值。自动标记触发疾步的敌人。

options.name: ECM Payload
options.description: Rolling Thunder deals 10 more damage (40 → 50 dmg) and destroys all enemy deployables.
options.descriptionZh: 雷声滚滚伤害增加 10（40 → 50 伤害），并摧毁所有敌方部署物。

options.name: Medal of Honor
options.description: Revive allies 25% faster. Double Time activates when running toward knocked allies.
options.descriptionZh: 复活队友速度提高 25%。朝倒地队友奔跑时会触发疾步。

options.name: Extra Traps
options.description: +1 Nox Gas Trap charge and +2 traps in the world.
options.descriptionZh: 诺克斯毒气陷阱充能 +1，场上可存在陷阱数量 +2。

options.name: Breathe It In
options.description: Regenerate 1 HP/sec while inside Nox gas.
options.descriptionZh: 处于诺克斯毒气中时，每秒恢复 1 生命值。

options.name: Particle Diffuser
options.description: Nox Gas Grenade has 50% larger radius.
options.descriptionZh: 诺克斯毒气手雷半径扩大 50%。

options.name: Gas Fighter
options.description: Nox Gas Trap recharges 300% faster while inside Nox gas.
options.descriptionZh: 处于诺克斯毒气中时，诺克斯毒气陷阱充能速度提高 300%。

options.name: Renaissance Man
options.description: Gain access to all class world interactions (Assault Bins, Care Package scans, Survey Beacons, and Ring Consoles).
options.descriptionZh: 获得所有职业的世界交互能力（突击兵补给箱、扫描补给舱、侦察信标和圆环控制台）。

options.name: Boozle-Eye
options.description: Bamboozles also scan the enemy who shoots the decoy.
options.descriptionZh: 诱饵骗术还会扫描射击诱饵的敌人。

options.name: Me Two
options.description: +1 Psyche Out charge. You can have two active decoys at once.
options.descriptionZh: 疯猫充能 +1。你可以同时拥有 2 个激活的诱饵。

options.name: Bamboozle Bonus
options.description: Psyche Out cooldown resets after a successful bamboozle.
options.descriptionZh: 成功诱骗后，疯猫冷却会重置。

options.name: Thick Skin
options.description: Take 25% less self-damage from Stim (20 dmg → 15 dmg).
options.descriptionZh: 兴奋剂对自身造成的伤害降低 25%（20 伤害 → 15 伤害）。

options.name: Squad Rush
options.description: All Launch Pad users gain Stim on landing.
options.descriptionZh: 所有使用跳板的玩家落地时获得兴奋剂。

options.name: Daredevil
options.description: Increase Stim Surge duration the less HP you have (up to 6 seconds).
options.descriptionZh: 生命值越低，兴奋剂冲刺持续时间越长（最多 6 秒）。

options.name: Triple Jump
options.description: Gain a third jump from Launch Pads.
options.descriptionZh: 从跳板获得第 3 次跳跃。

options.name: Help is Here
options.description: Gain all Support class perks.
options.descriptionZh: 获得所有支援型职业天赋。

options.name: Ultimate Conductor
options.description: Damage dealt converts to Ultimate charge. Knocks grant a 50% burst of charge.
options.descriptionZh: 造成的伤害会转化为终极技能充能。击倒会立即获得 50% 充能。

options.name: Energized Healer
options.description: Double the healing effect of small healing items ( and ).
options.descriptionZh: 小型治疗物品的回复效果翻倍。

options.name: Power Pylon
options.description: Interception Pylon gains double HP (300 HP Total), healing rate, and capacity.
options.descriptionZh: 拦截塔获得双倍生命值（总计 300 生命值）、治疗速率和容量。

options.name: Network Expansion
options.description: +25% range on Neurolink and Drone EMP. (30 m → 37.5 m)
options.descriptionZh: 神经链接与无人机 EMP 的作用范围增加 25%（30 米 → 37.5 米）。

options.name: Ally.MoveTo()
options.description: Crypto can Trailblaze to all allies.
options.descriptionZh: 密客可向任意队友发动「开路先锋」。

options.name: Power Coupling
options.description: Crypto gains Ultimate charge from using scan beacons and scanning enemies with his drone.
options.descriptionZh: 密客使用扫描信标，以及用无人机扫描敌人时，会获得终极技能充能。

options.name: Hackathon
options.description: Surveillance Drone cooldown reduced by 20 seconds (40s → 20s) and gain speed boost when activating Drone EMP or losing the drone.
options.descriptionZh: 监视无人机冷却时间减少 20 秒（40 秒 → 20 秒），并在启动无人机 EMP 或失去无人机时获得速度加成。

options.name: Ultimate Cooldown
options.description: Forged Shadows cooldown reduced by 30 seconds (180s → 150s).
options.descriptionZh: 锻造暗影冷却时间减少 30 秒（180 秒 → 150 秒）。

options.name: Try To Hide
options.description: Assassin's Instinct low health markers last twice as long.
options.descriptionZh: 刺客本能的低生命值标记持续时间翻倍。

options.name: Tactical Cooldown
options.description: Shadow Pounce cooldown reduced by 5 seconds (20s → 15s).
options.descriptionZh: 暗影突袭冷却时间减少 5 秒（20 秒 → 15 秒）。

options.name: Agile Assassin
options.description: Shadow Pounce activates and charge 50% faster.
options.descriptionZh: 暗影突袭启动和蓄力速度提高 50%。

options.name: Wolf's Claws
options.description: After teleporting with Burglar's Best Friend, get a speed boost and super fast weapon draw.
options.descriptionZh: 使用盗贼挚友传送后，获得速度加成和极快的武器拔出速度。

options.name: Shopping Spree
options.description: Your squad can take +1 extra item from Black Market Boutique (2 → 3).
options.descriptionZh: 你的小队可从黑市精品店额外拿取 +1 件物品（2 → 3）。

options.name: Escape Artist
options.description: After teleporting with Burglar's Best Friend, regenerate 25 shield HP (until taking damage).
options.descriptionZh: 使用盗贼挚友传送后，恢复 25 点护盾；受到伤害后停止恢复。

options.name: Brand New Bag
options.description: Gain one Purple Backpack in the next Care Package.
options.descriptionZh: 在下一个空投补给舱中获得 1 个紫色背包。

options.name: Combat Reserve
options.description: Gain extra ammo per inventory stack, extra grenade capacity, and automatically reload a stowed weapon. Red Weapon Supply Bin access was removed.
options.descriptionZh: 每组库存弹药数量增加，手雷携带容量增加，并会自动装填收起的武器。红色武器补给箱使用权限已移除。

options.name: Locked and Loaded
options.description: Faster reloads and infinite ammo when behind Amped Cover and Amped Shield is intact.
options.descriptionZh: 在强化掩体后方且强化护盾完好时，装填更快并拥有无限弹药。

options.name: Ramped Up
options.description: Mobile Minigun "Sheila"'s handling and spin-up time are improved by 20%.
options.descriptionZh: 移动机枪“希拉”的操控性和预热时间提升 20%。

options.name: Rebuild Module
options.description: Amped Cover will regenerate after not being damaged for a period of time.
options.descriptionZh: 强化掩体在一段时间未受伤害后会再生。

options.name: Gravity Boots
options.description: Pressing while in the air makes the player fall much faster.
options.descriptionZh: 在空中按下时，玩家会更快下落。

options.name: NEWT Scoot
options.description: After leaving Gravity Lift, press and holds while in the air makes you fall much slower.
options.descriptionZh: 离开引力升降机后，在空中按住会让你更慢下落。

options.name: Conservation Of Energy
options.description: Spacewalk now regenerates 25 shield HP when you soft land.
options.descriptionZh: 太空漫步现在会在软着陆时恢复 25 点护盾。

options.name: Knock Expert
options.description: +1 extra ability charge on knock.
options.descriptionZh: 击倒敌人时额外获得 +1 次技能充能。

options.name: Pyro Techniques
options.description: The Motherlode drops behind patches of fire for 8 seconds after the bombs explode
options.descriptionZh: 强势进入的炸弹爆炸后，会在身后留下持续 8 秒的火焰区域。

options.name: Knuckle Jumper
options.description: Jumping when next to your own Knuckle Cluster will give you an explosive boost (destroys the cluster afterwards).
options.descriptionZh: 在自己的霹雳爆破旁起跳会获得爆炸推进，并在之后摧毁该霹雳爆破。

options.name: Reignition
options.description: Dealing explosive damage to enemies recharges your ultimate (for every 2 damage dealt, reduces cooldown by 1 second).
options.descriptionZh: 对敌人造成爆炸伤害会为终极技能充能（每造成 2 点伤害，冷却减少 1 秒）。

options.name: Wreckless
options.description: -50% damage taken from explosives.
options.descriptionZh: 受到的爆炸伤害 -50%。

options.name: Eyes in the Sky
options.description: Reveal enemies through walls within 100 meters while skydiving; enemies in line of sight can still be revealed within 250 meters.
options.descriptionZh: 跳伞时显现 100 米内隔墙敌人；视线内敌人仍可在 250 米内被显现。

options.name: Full Coverage
options.description: Missile Swarm fires more missiles (4x3 pattern → 4x5 pattern) and gets 5 seconds shorter cooldown (30s → 25s).
options.descriptionZh: 飞弹流星发射更多导弹（4×3 阵型 → 4×5 阵型），冷却时间缩短 5 秒（30 秒 → 25 秒）。

options.name: Supersonic
options.description: Reduce Skyward Dive launch time by 40% (5.0s → 3.0s).
options.descriptionZh: 天际俯冲发射准备时间缩短 40%（5.0 秒 → 3.0 秒）。

options.name: Aerial Expert
options.description: Decreases jetpack activation cost, increased horizontal speed. Consumes fuel slightly faster.
options.descriptionZh: 降低喷气背包启动消耗，提高水平速度。燃料消耗略微加快。

options.name: Lasting Beats
options.description: Enemies that leave your ultimate radius are highlighted for 5 seconds.
options.descriptionZh: 离开你终极技能半径的敌人会被高亮 5 秒。

options.name: Energizing Focus
options.description: Landing your tactical on an enemy regenerates 25 shields (non-stackable).
options.descriptionZh: 战术技能命中敌人时，恢复 25 点护盾（不可叠加）。

options.name: Home Base
options.description: While you’re inside of your Ultimate radius your Tactical cooldown is reduced to 8 seconds.
options.descriptionZh: 当你位于自己的终极技能半径内时，战术技能冷却时间降低至 8 秒。

options.name: Split Focus
options.description: +1 Focus of Attention charge.
options.descriptionZh: 聚焦之心充能 +1。

options.name: Longer Reach
options.description: Increases Phase Breach range by 25m.
options.descriptionZh: 相位突破距离增加 25 米。

options.name: Ultimate Cooldown
options.description: Reduces Phase Breach cooldown by 30s.
options.descriptionZh: 相位突破冷却时间减少 30 秒。

options.name: Twin Snares
options.description: +1 Arc Snare charge.
options.descriptionZh: 电弧陷阱充能 +1。

options.name: Greedy Snare
options.description: Arc Snare lifetime tripled (5s → 15s) and it can snare multiple enemies.
options.descriptionZh: 电弧陷阱存在时间变为 3 倍（5 秒 → 15 秒），并可束缚多名敌人。

options.name: Gunrunning
options.description: Movement speed increased while holding SMGs and Pistols.
options.descriptionZh: 手持冲锋枪和手枪时移动速度提高。

options.name: Fire Ball
options.description: Wrecking Ball drops magma patches on the ground and Mad Maggie takes 50% less fire damage.
options.descriptionZh: 毁灭球会在地面留下岩浆区域，疯玛吉受到的火焰伤害降低 50%。

options.name: Drillslinger
options.description: +1 Riot Drill charge, but -25% drill duration (9s → 6.75s).
options.descriptionZh: 暴走钻头充能 +1，但钻头持续时间 -25%（9 秒 → 6.75 秒）。

options.name: Big Drill
options.description: +50% Riot Drill width and depth.
options.descriptionZh: 暴走钻头宽度和深度 +50%。

options.name: Stronghold
options.description: Castle Wall gets +500 HP (1250 HP total) and electrification lasts 120 seconds longer (120s → 240s).
options.descriptionZh: 终极城堡获得 +500 生命值（总计 1250 生命值），电能化持续时间延长 120 秒（120 秒 → 240 秒）。

options.name: Ready To Rumble
options.description: Reviving a player auto loads Newcastle's weapons and triggers full regen.
options.descriptionZh: 复活一名玩家会自动装填纽卡斯尔的武器，并触发完整恢复。

options.name: Ultimate Savior
options.description: When you slam down Castle Wall, allies in the impact zone get 15 seconds of shield regeneration.
options.descriptionZh: 落下终极城堡时，冲击区域内的队友获得 15 秒护盾恢复。

options.name: Defensive Line
options.description: Tactical and Revive Shield knocks back enemies once.
options.descriptionZh: 战术技能与复活护盾各可击退敌人一次。

options.name: Controlling my Prey
options.description: Gain all Controller class perks.
options.descriptionZh: 获得所有控制型职业天赋。

options.name: Improved Mark
options.description: Sniper's Mark marked enemies are briefly highlighted, their icon is visible through walls and their health bar is revealed to the squad.
options.descriptionZh: 被狙击手标记标记的敌人会短暂高亮，其图标可隔墙可见，且其生命值条会向小队显示。

options.name: Herd Tracker
options.description: Marking an enemy with Spotter's Lens marks the entire team.
options.descriptionZh: 用观察镜标记一名敌人时，会标记其整支队伍。

options.name: Sniper Cover
options.description: Adds a Gun Shield to Sniper's Mark.
options.descriptionZh: 为狙击手标记添加枪盾。

options.name: Hidden Spikes
options.description: Piercing Spikes are hidden while dormant.
options.descriptionZh: 穿刺尖刺休眠时处于隐藏状态。

options.name: Sole Piercer
options.description: Piercing Spikes activate twice as fast and deal more damages (15 → 20).
options.descriptionZh: 穿刺尖刺启动速度变为 2 倍，并造成更多伤害（15 → 20）。

options.name: Ferro-Door
options.description: Using Barricade on destroyed doors rebuilds the door.
options.descriptionZh: 对已被摧毁的门使用加固会重建该门。

options.name: Resilient Veil
options.description: Dark Veil lasts 5 seconds longer (15s → 20s).
options.descriptionZh: 黑暗面纱持续时间增加 5 秒（15 秒 → 20 秒）。

options.name: Extra Bullet
options.description: +1 Whistler charge.
options.descriptionZh: 智能子弹充能 +1。

options.name: Trap Mode
options.description: Whistler dart duration tripled (5s → 15s) and dart damage increased to 35 damage.
options.descriptionZh: 智能子弹飞镖持续时间变为 3 倍（5 秒 → 15 秒），飞镖伤害提高至 35 点。

options.name: Killing Time
options.description: Tempest duration increased by 15s (30s → 45s).
options.descriptionZh: 暴风雨持续时间增加 15 秒（30 秒 → 45 秒）。

options.name: Quiet Time
options.description: Whistler silences the player on impact instead of applying Overheat and also applies a 0.5s slowdown.
options.descriptionZh: 智能子弹命中时会沉默玩家，而不是施加过热，并且还会施加 0.5 秒减速。

options.name: Battpack
options.description: Carry +1 per stack (2 → 3) and see batteries counter over Death Boxes.
options.descriptionZh: 每格可多携带 1 个护盾电池（2 → 3），并显示死亡箱内的护盾电池数量。

options.name: Bigger Jam
options.description: Energy Barricade radius is increased by 10% (10m → 11m).
options.descriptionZh: 能量屏障半径增加 10%（10 米 → 11 米）。

options.name: Instant Barrier
options.description: A portion of Radiant Transfer's charge is applied instantly.
options.descriptionZh: 光芒转移的一部分充能会立即生效。

options.name: Enduring Barrier
options.description: Radiant Transfer's regen no longer gets paused when damaged.
options.descriptionZh: 光芒转移的恢复受到伤害时不再暂停。

options.name: Eye to Another World
options.description: Gain all Recon class perks.
options.descriptionZh: 获得所有侦察型职业天赋。

options.name: Controller of Worlds
options.description: Gain all Controller class perks.
options.descriptionZh: 获得所有控制型职业天赋。

options.name: Staring into the Void
options.description: Increases Void Passage scan time for Alter by 15 extra seconds.
options.descriptionZh: 变幻的虚空通道扫描时间额外增加 15 秒。

options.name: Void Breacher
options.description: Using a friendly Void Passage grants faster movement speed and reloads.
options.descriptionZh: 使用友方虚空通道后，获得更快移动速度和更快装填。

options.name: Hunt Target
options.description: Speed boost when running towards an enemy marked by Tracker Dart.
options.descriptionZh: 朝被追踪镖标记的敌人奔跑时获得速度加成。

options.name: Extra Traps
options.description: +1 Tracker Dart charge and +1 traps in the world.
options.descriptionZh: 追踪镖充能 +1，场上可存在陷阱数量 +1。

options.name: Life Syphon
options.description: Health and shield recovery upon damaging enemy with Stinger Bolt.
options.descriptionZh: 使用刺针弩箭对敌人造成伤害时，恢复生命值和护盾。

options.name: Alternate Mode
options.description: +2 Stinger Bolt charges (Total 3), but has fewer pulses and a smaller radius.
options.descriptionZh: 刺针弩箭充能 +2（总计 3），但脉冲次数更少、半径更小。

options.name: Sliding Shooter
options.description: Bullets shot while sliding come straight from inventory instead of magazine.
options.descriptionZh: 滑行时射出的子弹直接来自库存，而不是弹匣。

options.name: Long Haul
options.description: Increase Nitro Gate effect duration to 5 seconds (3s -> 5s).
options.descriptionZh: 氮气闸门效果持续时间增加至 5 秒（3 秒 → 5 秒）。

options.name: Jump Gate
options.description: Upgrades the Nitro Gate to give a double-jump.
options.descriptionZh: 升级氮气闸门，使其提供二段跳。

options.name: Super Slider
options.description: Reduce Nitro Gate cooldown by 5 seconds (25s -> 20s) and increase maximum in-world Nitro Gate amount by 1 (2 -> 3).
options.descriptionZh: 氮气闸门冷却时间减少 5 秒（25 秒 → 20 秒），场上氮气闸门最大数量 +1（2 → 3）。
